propositions: A deterministic shadow comparator must consume the same call/result set as legacy and RP-06 projections, compare criterion selection/order/identity/context/model/budget/posture/disposition against an allowlist of approved deltas, and never issue provider calls or control the final verdict.

A repository-policy/contract guard must fail when review gates bypass CriteriaSnapshot for direct routing reads, when a second discovery scheduler is introduced outside the shared kernel, or when per-unit trace fields enter review/review-status schemas.

The live external-provider-matrix canary (tests/external/test_review_discovery_live.py with external+llm_live markers) must exercise the real default discovery path, prove at least one discovery call reaches the configured provider per arm, assert a narrow final verdict (PASS/BLOCK), and retain the reducer-ignored internal journal without printing secrets or trace.

Cross-gate integration fixtures (no overlay, disable/retune, project LLM, budget shed, local/systemic failure, cancellation, legacy checkpoint) must produce approved final dispositions and trace outcomes with exact field-level matching.

Documentation in docs/review-kernel.md must state snapshot/executor/gate/RP-01 ownership, approved deltas, sensitive-data boundary, shadow behavior, and that rollback is a code revert to the retained compatibility projection with no journal rewrite.

The live external-provider-matrix run (GitHub Actions run 32579533715, merged commit 4d6c1cc835e0) exercised all three provider arms (anthropic/openai/bedrock) and the canary passed with >=1 real discovery call per arm recorded, proving the cross-gate cutover at the real provider boundary.
